gloss: to sprawl; to lie down lazily

definitions.gloss: to sprawl; to lie down lazily; to lounge around
definitions.explanation: To lie stretched out in a relaxed, often careless manner. Implies a casual, idle posture rather than sleeping.

examples.japanese: ソファーに{寝|ね}そべる。
{猫|ねこ}が{日当|ひあ}たりのいい{場所|ばしょ}で{寝|ね}そべっている。
examples.english: The cat is sprawled out in a sunny spot.

examples.japanese: {休日|きゅうじつ}は{一日中|いちにちじゅう}{芝生|しばふ}に{寝|ね}そべって{本|ほん}を{読|よ}んでいた。
examples.english: On my day off, I spent the whole day lying on the grass reading a book.

notes:
{寝|ね}そべる is an intransitive godan verb. It emphasizes a relaxed, sprawled-out posture — not sleeping, but lying down idly.

ASPECT (ている):
{寝|ね}そべっている describes someone currently lying sprawled out.

PARTICLE PATTERNS:
- ～に{寝|ね}そべる (to sprawl on a surface)
- ～で{寝|ね}そべる (to lounge around in a place)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ソファーに{寝|ね}そべる (to sprawl on the sofa)
- {床|ゆか}に{寝|ね}そべる (to sprawl on the floor)
- {芝生|しばふ}に{寝|ね}そべる (to lie on the grass)

RELATED WORDS:
{横|よこ}になる is a neutral way to say "to lie down." {寝|ね}そべる adds the nuance of doing so lazily or casually, often with limbs spread out.
